ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf-ci detected p95 regression on gateway/small-batch (+35% vs baseline). Job nightly-smallbatch-2026-03-17. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/5181234567 :rotating_light:

mira: saw the alert, pinging eng-runtime. I'm seeing ~+200ms p95 in us-west on the smallbatch job. I'm online for the next 30m to triage.

devon: perf owners who's on call? can someone grab the profiler snapshot and the trace? ci-bot shows trace_id=trc-9f3b in the artifacts.

alex: I can try a quick repro — can you paste the exact command to run the bench?

mira: repro command:
```bash
./run_bench --suite=smallbatch --samples=100 --seed=42 --region=us-west
```
short log snippet from the artifact:
```
2026-03-17T23:12:01Z [batcher] scheduling delay=18.4ms
2026-03-17T23:12:01Z [worker] decode p95=34ms
2026-03-17T23:12:01Z [overall] p95=260ms
```

sam: fyi, PR #3491 landed yesterday — changes to batcher scheduling heuristics. tagging anyone who touched that: @devon @mira. could be related. :thinking_face: 

devon: good catch. alex try running with the heuristic disabled: `--batcher-heuristic=off` and compare p95. if it drops, we have a strong signal.

alex: running now with `--batcher-heuristic=off` against the same seed. first 100 samples show p95 ~250ms -> 240ms -> after flag p95 ~232ms (~10ms improvement). uploading quick plot: https://ci.redwood.ai/plots/5181234567/quick.png

mira: that's a useful signal (small but consistent). proposed plan: rollback heuristic in a canary (3 nodes in us-west) + run extended smoke (2k samples) overnight. if green, promote; if not, revert canary and bisect PRs.

ops-bot: Canary deploy initiated: canary-smallbatch-heuristic-off -> targets: 3 nodes (us-west). status: STARTED.

sam: noted. I'll queue a bisect across PRs that touched batcher tomorrow morning if canary doesn't improve. leaving :eyes: on CI.

mira: thanks everyone. if anyone finds a golden trace or a clear reproducer, paste it here with trace_id. otherwise we'll reconvene on the morning handoff. :thumbsup:
